text:
samir: After reading the latest postmortem, I want to pilot a tighter follow-up loop: 'remediation microcycle' (10 days) + a tiny public scoreboard for follow-through. Idea: short lifecycle, daily tiny updates, and a visible score so teams can see momentum. Thoughts?

elaine: Nice. Microcycles could reduce context loss. Recommend mandatory "next-step" field on each remediation card so it's always actionable.

marvin: For scoreboard, propose simple metrics: open_count, closed_in_cycle, avg_days_to_plan, percent_ack_on_time. Show at top of weekly ops note. Keep it lightweight.

toni: Suggest automation: when a remediation card is created, add fields: owner, contact, next_step, due_in_days, recurrence_tag. Then the board can auto-calc the score.

ops-bot: NOTE: incidents webhook can add incident id to cards; automation can compute ack timeliness. See /webhooks/incidents.

samir: Draft microcycle timeline:
1) Day 0: create remediation card with next_step + owner + due_in_days (<=10)
2) Day 1-9: daily one-line progress comment (can be short)
3) Day 10: either closed or moved to next microcycle with escalation note

elaine: Escalation rules: no activity in 48h -> ping secondary; no activity in 96h -> escalation to team lead and add to next sprint planning. Keep it automated where possible.

marvin: recurrence_tag suggestions: capacity, routing, cache, regression, 3p, infra-config. We'll use recurrence_count to track repeats. If recurrence_count >= 3 then flag for cross-team deep-fix.

toni: Template to paste into remediation cards (one-liners):
```
owner: @handle
contact: handle@redwood.ai
next_step: (one-line)
due_in_days: 10
recurrence_tag: capacity|routing|cache|regression|3p|infra-config
recurrence_count: 0
microcycle_start: YYYY-MM-DD
```

samir: Scoreboard calc proposal (simple):
- follow_through_score = min(100, 50 * closed_in_cycle / open_count + 50 * percent_ack_on_time)
- display top 5 open remediations by recurrence_count in weekly ops note

elaine: Pilot plan:
- Run 3 microcycles (30 days total) across infra and platform teams
- Use GH project board with the template fields and enable an automation for daily reminder comments
- Measure follow_through_score, closed_in_cycle, avg_days_to_plan, recurrence trends

marvin: I'll wire a GH Action to add missing fields and ping owners after 48h inactivity. Prototype by Fri.

toni: I'll add the scoreboard widget to the weekly ops note template and a Grafana panel that joins GH card labels with incident tags. Due next Wed.

samir: Concrete action items:
- marvin -> GH Action prototype for field enforcement + inactivity pings (due Fri)
- toni -> Ops note scoreboard + Grafana mock (due next Wed)
- elaine -> update postmortem checklist to require next_step + microcycle_start (due Tue)
- samir -> schedule first microcycle kickoff + create GH project board (due Mon)
Pilot length: 30 days (3 microcycles); we'll retro after and decide whether to adopt.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "microcycle-kickoff" in 2 days (participants: samir, elaine, marvin, toni).

elaine: One small ask: keep daily updates _tiny_ (one sentence) so it doesn't feel heavy.

marvin: Agreed. I'll prototype a tiny slash command to post one-line progress to the card.

toni: :thumbsup: will share the ops note template once Grafana mock is up.

samir: Thanks all — I'll link this thread in the current postmortem and add the action items. Ping me if you want to co-run the first microcycle.

ops-bot: Note: please keep remediation card titles in the format "incident-<id> - short-desc" for metric joins.
